content: While paragraph-level valence analysis is quick and simple, it is sometimes too coarse because we aim to understand the sentiment directed towards the target group, not just nearby in the text. For example, suppose the target group is named “B". A sentence such as “A violently attacked B" would likely have extremely negative valence, but the writer may not feel negatively towards the victim, “B".
